Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing claim files and compensation under the industrial insurance laws.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to claim files and compensation under theindustrial insurance laws; amending RCW 51.08.173; adding new sectionsto chapter 51.08 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 51.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Thirdparty administrator" means any entity that contracts toadminister workers' compensation claims for selfinsured employersqualified under RCW 51.14.020 and certified pursuant to RCW 51.14.030,or provides claims administration, monitoring, or review for anyemployer, and is considered to be an employer representative.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 51.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Claims management entity" means any individual designated by aselfinsured employer qualified under RCW 51.14.020 and certifiedpursuant to RCW 51.14.030 to administer workers' compensation claimsincluding selfadministered organizations and thirdparty p. 1 HB 1355administrators, or provides claims administration, monitoring, orreview for any employer, and is considered to be an employerrepresentative.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 51.08.173 and 1983 c 174 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Selfinsurer" or "selfinsured employer" means an employer orgroup of employers which has been authorized under this title to carryits own liability to its employees covered by this title.
This act applies to all claims open afterJanuary 1, 2014.
